scopes.appointments: Melihat dan membuat janji temu demo. Needed to create a demo appointment and to see demo bookings. Viewing the public doctor schedule does not need it.
scopes.poppy:browser-sign-in: Use the website signed in, with the other access you approve. Needed only to browse the website signed in after sign-in; discovery and the public schedule work without it.

apis.description: Jadwal dokter, janji temu demo, dan pembayaran demo
